identity: University of Groningen Religious Studies / Religiewetenschappen, RIO 50902, programme registry row 218, English-taught 180 EC bachelor.
sourceUse: 2026–2027 TER adopted 27 August 2026. Articles 4.1 and 7.1 specify the complete ordinary pathway. Degree page supports the disciplinary scope, cultural and political choice and the breadth of methods. Choose the cultural and political specialisation for its wider public-life scope compared with the textual Origins option, independently of UCR fit.
components: Concepts and Methods 1: Study of Religion
The Text Awakens: Reading and Using Religious Texts
Ordinary 15 EC university or approved personal minor from another faculty. Quranic Arabic 1 with an optional module is an alternative.
First of three faculty options; select two.
Second faculty option; optional module is the unselected third alternative.
Cultural and Political Impact of Religion
One of two specialisations. The other is Origins of Religion: Foundational Texts and their Transformations.
Requires 60 EC from years two and three, including Concepts and Methods 2.

progression.year-two: TER art. 9.3: at least 45 EC in the propaedeutic phase, with applicable unit prerequisites. Pass Concepts and Methods 1 before the Concepts and Methods 2 examination. Pass both methods courses before the Religion, Diversity and Identity examination.
progression.year-three: Complete the first-year phase before ordinary third-year units and the minor. The 15 EC minor is offered by another faculty; Quranic Arabic 1 plus an optional module is a separate option. Choose two of three faculty units and one of two specialisations. This comparison selects the two named faculty units. Alternatives such as study abroad, work placement, education and spiritual care are conditioned alternatives, not additional compulsory credits.
progression.thesis: Complete 60 EC from years two and three, including Concepts and Methods 2, before the thesis examination. The 7.5 EC seminar and 10 EC thesis are separate.

catalogueCorroboration.finding: Confirms the 7.5 EC Cultural and Political Impact of Religion specialisation. The catalogue description is empty; the TER and general degree profile govern the broader-scope rationale.
